runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and competitors derived by the analyst from the 10-K. Price **$2.53** (2026-10-29, live quote via tools/run.py, aggregator, flagged) x **17,718,161 common shares** (10-Q cover to 2026-06-30, accession 0001654954-26-007650, as of 2026-08-10; single class, no treasury) = cap **$44.8M**; sovereign **5.37%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-28). The 1-for-10 reverse split of 2025-12-26 noted; ATM sales after 2026-08-10 and conversion of $3,020,000 of 10% notes at $3.00 not counted. Filings: 10-K FY2025 0001654954-26-003094, 10-K/A 0001654954-26-004179, 10-Qs 0001654954-26-007650 and 0001654954-26-004903, DEF 14A 0001654954-26-007870, 8-Ks 0001654954-26-009210, 0001654954-26-008681, 0001654954-26-007728, 0001654954-26-007472, 0001193125-25-318380, 424B5 0001654954-26-007452; FY2025 operating cash $(14,326,205) cross-checked against the filed statement. **Q1 OUT**: a start-up in substance on its own 10-K ("a limited operating history with no material revenues", "subject to all the risks inherent in a new business"); FY2025 revenue $215,037, net loss $20,975,052; going-concern paragraph in the auditor's report; patent applications only, core technology licensed from Duke; the 2021 reverse merger of private 374Water into the PowerVerde shell. Q2 to Q12 NOT REACHED. Balance sheet: a shell before 2021; accumulated deficit -$3.2M to -$57.2M at 2026-06-30; equity rises only on share sales; $1.78M cash against $2.96M of 10% convertible notes at 2026-06-30, $2.30M operating cash used in the half-year. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: material weaknesses in internal control; FY2025 equipment revenue negative after the OC San contract delay; the CFO terminated with a demand of at least $433,500; note conversion price cut from $5.00 to $3.00 and warrant price from $7.50 to $4.50 on 2026-05-26 with directors holding $700,000 of the notes (the box line carries "integrity facts recorded, not judged"); shares up about 40% since 2022 with three ATM programmes; CEO pay $7.5M in 2024 against $445K of revenue; counter-evidence recorded: OC San, Olathe, Orlando and Defense Department work, a narrower first-half 2026 loss. Competitors: the 10-K names none; not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after every real cost (stock pay and stock issued for services deducted, capex and intangible spending) FY2021 -$2.05M, FY2022 -$5.70M, FY2023 -$10.14M, FY2024 -$12.84M, FY2025 -$20.06M, average -$10.16M, negative every year; specific (b), the no-growth case alone; net debt $1.29M at 2026-06-30; value range -$10.75 a share; fair price not positive, -$5.81 all-equity (central), -$5.73 equity-only; reported as none. Could not get: ATM sales after 2026-08-10; stock issued for services in FY2021 and FY2022 (read as zero); the 2026-10-29 investor presentation, not opened. Framework gaps for the operator: Q1 lists start-ups as OUT but sends a significant new technology to TOO HARD, and this name is both; the fair-price definition averages two end cases with no wording for a single case or a non-positive fair price; tools/run.py misses stock issued for services as stock pay. Write-early: the run closed at Q1 and went in two commits (template and notes, then the rest), declared by the analyst. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, 4 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged (the analyst's own check: 20 ids, 9 fragments); no tracked research file over 200 KB; raw filings in the ignored cache. Contamination declared: one filtered listing of Test Runs for scwo, 374, powerverde and vyrex before re-reading the blind rule, which returned nothing (self-audit box left unticked); TURV commit subjects; the memory index; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1: a supercritical-water-oxidation waste-destruction start-up, reverse-merged into the PowerVerde shell in 2021, with $215K of FY2025 revenue against a $21.0M loss, a going-concern paragraph and funding by share sales and convertible notes repriced in 2026; computation only, owner cash negative every year, value about -$10.75 a share. Not armed.
